title: Inventions at home
text: We use many inventions every day. We do not think about them, but they are all very important. Look around your house!

In the morning, I wake up and I turn on the light. The light bulb is a great invention. Before the light bulb, people used candles. Then I brush my teeth with a toothbrush. The first toothbrushes were from China.
In the kitchen we have a fridge. It keeps our food cold and fresh. We also have a microwave. We heat our food in one or two minutes.
My brother and I play video games on the television. My parents watch films. We do not live without the internet: we send messages and we talk with our family.
In the bathroom there is a toilet. It is a very old invention, but it is still very important. What is your favorite invention at home?
q: What did people use before the light bulb?
Where were the first toothbrushes from?
It keeps food cold and fresh
How fast does the microwave heat food?
What do we do with the internet?
halves: The toilet is a very old invention...

grammar.title: Grammar: the present simple (I, you, we, they)
grammar.rule: With I, you, we and they, the verb has no -s. For the negative, use do not + verb.

es.sub: Cosas de casa que alguien inventó
